observed_red: The current driver emits separate LSL+ADD for x+(y<<3), MUL+ADD for x+y*z, SXTB+ADD for x+y and LSL+ADD+LDR for p[i]. N01 ranks addressing, compute, moves and extensions after the completed constant/frame slices. These examples establish missed idioms, not a measured TU savings promise.

scope.included: Emission-only composition of adjacent, already allocated instructions: constant shift plus integer ADD/SUB/AND/ORR/EOR or CMP; sign/zero extension plus ADD/SUB or CMP; MUL plus ADD/SUB; X-width ADD plus a nonvolatile scalar Load/Store at offset zero, optionally preceded by a legal LSL index. Existing MIR, allocation, verifier, EvoIR and interpreter semantics are unchanged.
scope.excluded: Non-adjacent motion, CFG rewrites, SIMD accesses, atomic/volatile access fusion, inline assembly, relocation arithmetic, guard deletion/folding, new MIR opcodes, multiply-negate algebra, general result constant folding, post/pre-index writeback. Other N03d opportunities remain open for a separate measured disposition.
scope.admission: Each eliminated temporary has exactly one definition and one explicit use in the entire allocated function, including arguments, terminators, spill and assembly operands. Width/class and count bounds are checked before emission. All surviving inputs refer to their pre-sequence physical values; if a removed definition overwrites a distinct surviving input, decline. No other instruction, guard or effect may lie inside the sequence.
scope.state_relation: Preserve final result bits, every live value, NZCV except the original CMP result, and the original single memory access including width/alignment/address. Dead temporary physical contents need not agree. No scratch register or memory access is added.
scope.default: OFF. Kernel markers and explicit frame-pointer requests suppress all new choices, as for C1 and N03f. Default admission remains separate.

interface.driver: Extend --isel-opt to a duplicate-free list containing constants and local. Canonical header order is constants,local. Existing constants-only and OFF spelling remain byte-identical. The exact IR adapter and existing native-test hook use the same parser.
interface.patterns: Extend the existing targets/aarch64/patterns and costs plus their generator, not a new DSL or registry. Generated rows enumerate each admitted sequence family, widths, shifts and state contract. Costs select no semantic rule.
interface.telemetry: An optional development adapter report counts observed adjacent candidates, selected sequences, eliminated instructions and declined reasons. It does not mutate input IR, emit certificates or expand acceptance; existing S1/N01 tools measure actual objects.

red: Real-driver fixtures for W/X shifted arithmetic, sign extension, multiply-add/subtract, shifted/unshifted indexed load/store and CMP with ordered flags.
Multi-use and multiply-defined temporaries, cross-block/terminator uses, physical alias collisions, width mismatch, shift count equal to width and SUB/CMP operand reversal must decline.
Memory negatives: nonzero offset, volatile, atomic, SIMD and strict-alignment byte-expansion paths; store value aliasing a removed temporary.
Protected profiles, invalid/duplicate option lists and constants/frame interactions; OFF exact output.
Native before/after execution with boundary/random inputs and NZCV sentinels; both OS assemblers; existing MIR/interpreter/native corpora and independent allocation verifier unchanged.

acceptance.baseline: Reuse C1's committed OFF receipts and per-case hashes. Retired payloads are rebuilt only as needed, never relabeled. OFF objects must match those hashes exactly.
acceptance.native: 384 Darwin and 384 sealed Linux cases ON/OFF, identical object twins and matching execution. Focused cases must actually exercise every admitted family and negative boundary.
acceptance.six_units: Freeze six-unit A/B plans before running them: OFF regression, local-only and cumulative frame+constants+local; checked/unchecked separately, same verified IR/chain/bundle, original selected-TU harnesses, zero completed proof rejections or bundle failures. Prior opaque/source-bridge limits remain.
acceptance.bounds: No measured object text or text+rodata growth; compile median at most 1.25x matched OFF; interpreter steps and outputs unchanged. Use S1/N01 category totals and retain per-family selection counts; do not credit these gains to EqSat.
gates: focused Rust and touched Python tests
acceptance.stop: Repair or decline a faulty family rather than broaden admission. If eligible counts or savings are zero, freeze that result; do not claim closure of unexamined N03d/N07 work.

resources.retention: Keep summaries, hashes and minimal reproducers. Retire intermediate objects after measurement; no full disassembly retention, new target/workspace/kernel tree or VM disk. Record evidence/cache net delta; protect open evidence and Lean cache.

claim_ceiling: Opt-in local emission idioms tested on the frozen population. Not a new semantic domain, verified EqSat benefit, proved backend, default/kernel/full-application/latency acceptance or the completion of N03d/N07.
